28: After the death of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, his devious son takes power and demotes Maximus, one of Rome's most capable generals who Marcus preferred. Eventually, Maximus is forced to become a gladiator and battle to the death against other men for the amusement of paying audiences.

It's the oldest con in the book.

The School Teacher as an Old Man (voice)

Lil Deville / Phil DeVille / Betty DeVille (voice)

Was His Face Red . . . And His Nose, Too ! when the bandits took the money . . . and the SAFE !

Never was so much owed by so many to so few.
Air Chief Marshal Sir Hugh Dowding

Proof Can Be a Powerful Weapon.

As great as "Mutiny on the Bounty"

We all pay for our crimes in the end.

A red, white and blue-blooded comedy.

14620: The encounters of two people who run into each other on several occasions under circumstances ranging from friendly to hostile to loving. Along many years and countless run-ins, the two despise each other, befriend each other, and fall in love with each other—in no particular order.

Don't do it with your eyes closed.

Fall in love... With the beat

The sun dawned bloodied... two great armies met face to face... and the earth trembled to the sound of the Zulu death chant!

What actually happened that night in the woods?
Tom Branski, Technical Director of 'Fact or Fiction'
Clair Deforest, Editor for the Prosecution

If you thought you knew the world of Lego, YOU DON'T KNOW BRICK!

How much is your family worth?

My name is Leo and I have a secret
The Man with the Broken Face (voice)
The Nervous Little Man / The Safecracker / The Exterminator (voice)

HE FOUGHT FOR MAN... and lost a woman!

The principal of the training school

The night is young. He isn't.

It's time to get him back...

Falling in love is a state of change.

You'll want to be there when the fun starts!

32284: Abandoned by her father, a girl adjusts to life in an orphanage.

Relationships have rules...but some rules were meant to be...OPEN.

You can't soar until someone lifts you up.
33564: The story of some neighbors with different life styles..
33820: A couple's vacation to Ireland transforms into a nightmare as a virus spreads from slaughtered animals to humans, causing the dead to rise and feast on the living.
It's not what you eat, it's who you eat!
34076: A deranged man hides in the attic of a new house and becomes obsessed with the unsuspecting family that moves in.
You can't lock him out. He's already in.
34332: Kate and her daughter Beth live alone in an isolated farmhouse in the woods, but when Kate slowly begins to suspect that something sinister is happening, her motherly instincts are put to the test.

35356: In a fight for their lives, two dancers infiltrate a high-profile social club and seek the help of a newfound ally to unmask traitors to Siam.
An enchanted place where dreams meet reality. An extraordinary journey. Beyond imagination.

He must conquer evil on land and at sea!

The arrival, at a nearby cove, of a group of boat people will throw these moments of reflection into turmoil.

Mary Jean is just dying to get in the movies… She's about to get her wish.

The woman of flame -- the man of steel -- together !

See! The Earth Destroyed In A Nuclear Holocaust!

High Fashion. High Finance. High Life.

One lake, a million birds, an incredible story!

TWO MEN LOVED THIS MURDERED WOMEN ...That's All The Police Know

...a little fun goes a long way.

See It...Find Out What It Means!

The finest array of entertainment ever offered!

EVIL ENTERS THE HOUSE AT 13 WEST STREET... IT'S SHOCKING AS A SCREAM IN THE NIGHT!!!!

No Matter How Far You Go, You Can't Run From Family

Discover the wonder. Follow the magic. Find the promised land.

26.5 million reasons to break the rules.
